<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Sesión 2 — Planificar y Revisar</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ───────────── Palette (pop noche) ───────────── */

:root {
  --radius: 20px;
  --title-size: 58px;
}

:root {
  --bg: #15153a;
  --bg-pattern: radial-gradient(#ffffff16 2px, transparent 2px);
  --bg-size: 28px 28px;
  --ink: #fdf6e3;
  --muted: #a9a6d6;
  --card: #262660;
  --line: #fdf6e3;
  --border: 3px solid #fdf6e3;
  --shadow: 8px 8px 0 #05051a;
  --a1: #ff5c8a;
  --a2: #5b8cff;
  --a3: #ffd166;
  --a4: #06d6a0;
  --good: #06d6a0;
  --bad: #ff5c5c;
  --mascot: #ffd166;
  --mascot-ink: #15153a;
  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --term-bg: #05051a;
  --term-ink: #fdf6e3;
}

/* ───────────── Stage ───────────── */

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  transition: background .4s, color .4s;
}

body {
  background-image: var(--bg-pattern);
  background-size: var(--bg-size);
}

#deck {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 1280px;
  height: 720px;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.slide {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: 50px 72px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(60px) scale(.98);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.2);
}

.slide.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: none;
}

.slide.past { transform: translateX(-60px) scale(.98); }

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}

h1 { font-size: 104px; }
h2 { font-size: var(--title-size); white-space: nowrap; }
h3 { font-size: 30px; }

p { margin: 0; }

.big { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.25; }
.mid { font-size: 30px; }
.small { font-size: 22px; color: var(--muted); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.center { text-align: center; }
.hl { color: var(--a1); }

.card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 22px 26px;
}

.slide > .mascot { position: absolute; right: 80px; bottom: 50px; --size: 130px; }

/* ───────────── Fragments ───────────── */

[data-step] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(18px);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.4);
}

[data-step].on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.f-drop { transform: translateY(-120px) rotate(-8deg); }
.f-drop.on { transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); }
.f-flip { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(-95deg); transform-origin: left center; }
.f-flip.on { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(0); }
.f-pop { transform: scale(.3); }
.f-pop.on { transform: scale(1); }

/* ───────────── Mascot ───────────── */

.mascot {
  width: var(--size, 120px);
  height: var(--size, 120px);
  display: inline-block;
}

.mascot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; animation: bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot.jump svg { animation: jump .6s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .6s infinite; }
.mascot.bigjump svg { animation: bigjump .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .9s infinite; }
.mascot.shake svg { animation: shake .12s linear infinite; }

@keyframes bob { 50% { transform: translateY(-5px) scaleY(1.02); } }
@keyframes jump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.15, .85); } 50% { transform: translateY(-90px) scale(.92, 1.1) rotate(-6deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.12, .88); } 100% { transform: none; } }
@keyframes bigjump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.2, .8); } 45% { transform: translateY(-150px) rotate(-200deg); } 70% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(-360deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.15, .85) rotate(-360deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-2deg); } 75% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(2deg); } }
@keyframes wave { 50% { transform: rotate(-22deg); } }

.mascot .arm { transform-origin: 84px 60px; animation: wave .5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot .drop { animation: drip 1.1s ease-in infinite; }
.mascot .qmark { animation: qbob 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 80px 4px; }
.mascot .steam { animation: steam .35s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes qbob { to { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(12deg); } }
@keyframes steam { to { opacity: .4; transform: translate(2px, -2px); } }
@keyframes drip { 0% { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 0; } 30% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(14px); opacity: 0; } }

.confetti { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 18px; border-radius: 3px; pointer-events: none; animation: confetti 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2, .6, .4, 1) forwards; }
@keyframes confetti { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)); opacity: 0; } }

/* ───────────── Track ───────────── */

.track {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding-top: 64px;
}

.track .stop {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 22px;
  text-align: center;
}

.track .stop::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  right: 50%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--line);
  opacity: .18;
}

.track .stop:first-child::before { display: none; }
.track .stop.lit::before { background: var(--a2); opacity: 1; }

.track .dot {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--card);
  border: var(--border);
  transition: background .3s, transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8);
}

.track .stop.lit .dot { background: var(--a2); transform: scale(1.2); }

.track .stop.finish .dot {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  margin-top: -5px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: conic-gradient(#111 25%, #fff 0 50%, #111 0 75%, #fff 0) 0 0 / 14px 14px;
}

.track .stop.finish.lit .dot { transform: scale(1.3) rotate(-8deg); }

.track .rider {
  position: absolute;
  top: -18px;
  --size: 78px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 20;
  transition: left .6s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.3, .5, 1), opacity .3s;
}

.track.draw .stop { opacity: 0; animation: stopIn .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.6) forwards; }
@keyframes stopIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px) scale(.6); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.track.mini { padding-top: 0; transform: scale(.72); transform-origin: top left; width: 139%; margin-bottom: -18px; }
.track.mini .rider { top: -70px; --size: 60px; }
.steps-slide .track .rider { --size: 100px; top: -44px; }

/* ───────────── Slide-specific ───────────── */

/* portada */
.cover { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; }
.cover .kicker { font-size: 32px; color: var(--muted); }
.cover h1 { white-space: nowrap; }
.cover h1 .cursor { display: inline-block; width: .45em; height: .85em; background: var(--a1); vertical-align: -.06em; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
.cover .mascot { position: absolute; right: 110px; bottom: 90px; --size: 220px; }
.cover .mascot.enter { animation: dropIn .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) both; }
@keyframes dropIn { from { transform: translateY(-600px) rotate(-20deg); } to { transform: none; } }

/* cómo les fue */
.notes4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 28px; margin-top: 60px; }
.notes4 .card { height: 250px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; }
.notes4 .card .emo { font-size: 60px; align-self: flex-end; }
.notes4 .card:nth-child(1) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 45%, var(--card)); }
.notes4 .card:nth-child(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 30%, var(--card)); }
.notes4 .card:nth-child(3) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 32%, var(--card)); }
.notes4 .card:nth-child(4) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 32%, var(--card)); }

/* qué aprendimos */
.checks { display: flex; gap: 60px; height: 50px; margin: 30px 0 16px 8px; font-size: 32px; }
.checks span { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.4); transition: .35s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8); }
.checks span.on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.barwrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
.bar { display: flex; gap: 5px; padding: 8px; border: var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--card); box-shadow: var(--shadow); width: 900px; height: 72px; }
.bar .seg { flex: 1; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; transition: background .08s; }
.bar .seg.lit { background: var(--a2); }
.bar.chaos { animation: shake .09s linear infinite; }
.bar.chaos .seg.lit { background: var(--a1); }
.bar .seg.fall { transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.5, 0, .9, .5), opacity 1.1s; opacity: 0; }
.pct { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 48px; min-width: 150px; }
.qs { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.qs span { position: absolute; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; color: var(--a1); animation: qpop .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8) both, qfloat 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes qpop { from { transform: scale(0) rotate(-40deg); } }
@keyframes qfloat { to { translate: 0 -18px; rotate: 12deg; } }
.learned .msg { margin-top: 80px; }
.learned > .mascot { --size: 150px; }
.tagline { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; padding: 6px 14px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 22px; }

/* planificar */
.section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; }
.section h1 { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.section .track { margin-top: 40px; }

/* recorrido */
.route { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 26px; margin-top: 150px; }
.route .card { min-height: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.3; padding: 24px 22px; }
.route .card .ico { font-size: 50px; line-height: 1; }
.route .card h3 { margin: 0; }
.route .card.finish { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 45%, var(--card)); }
.route .card.bump { animation: bump .35s ease-out; }
@keyframes bump { 40% { transform: translateY(8px) scaleY(.97); } }
.route .hopper { position: absolute; --size: 110px; left: -140px; top: -96px; opacity: 0; transition: left .6s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .4, 1), opacity .3s; z-index: 3; }
.route-slide h2 { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* slider */
.slider-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-size: 30px; margin: 50px 0 40px; }
input[type=range] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; flex: 1; height: 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 15%, transparent); outline: none; }
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a1); border: var(--border); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--line); cursor: grab; }
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--a1); border: var(--border); cursor: grab; }
.dec { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 330px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin: 14px 0; font-size: 30px; }
.chips { display: flex; gap: 12px; min-height: 62px; }
.chip { width: 58px; height: 58px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); animation: chipIn .35s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8) both; }
.chip.yes { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 35%, var(--card)); }
.chip.no { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); font-family: var(--font-display); }
@keyframes chipIn { from { transform: scale(0) rotate(-30deg); } }

.slider-slide .slider-row { margin: 26px 0 22px; }
.slider-slide > .mascot { --size: 100px; top: 40px; right: 70px; bottom: auto; }
.curves { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; margin-top: 62px; }
.curve { width: 100%; height: 232px; overflow: visible; }
.curve .axis { fill: none; stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; }
.curve .fn { fill: none; stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; }
.curve[data-f="retrabajo"] .fn, .curve[data-f="retrabajo"] .pt circle { stroke: var(--a1); }
.curve[data-f="entender"] .fn, .curve[data-f="entender"] .pt circle { stroke: var(--a4); }
.curve .guide { fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-dasharray: 6 7; transition: d .35s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.2, .5, 1); }
.curve .pt { transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.2, .5, 1); }
.curve .pt circle { fill: var(--ink); stroke-width: 5; }
.curve text { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 22px; fill: var(--ink); }
.curve .xlbl { fill: var(--muted); text-anchor: end; }

/* terminal */
.term { font-variant-ligatures: none; background: var(--term-bg); color: var(--term-ink); border-radius: 16px; border: var(--border); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 0 0 22px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 26px; overflow: hidden; }
.term .bar3 { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; background: #ffffff14; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.term .bar3 i { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5f57; }
.term .bar3 i:nth-child(2) { background: #febc2e; }
.term .bar3 i:nth-child(3) { background: #28c840; }
.term .line { padding: 6px 28px; min-height: 46px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; }
.term .line .p { color: var(--a3); }
.term .line .tag { margin-left: auto; font-size: 30px; }
.term .caret { display: inline-block; width: 13px; height: 28px; background: var(--term-ink); animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; vertical-align: middle; }
.term .bar3 .title { margin-left: 12px; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); }
.chat .viewport { height: 418px; overflow: hidden; }
.chat .feed { transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1, .4, 1); }
.chat .line { min-height: 0; padding: 4px 28px; font-size: 22px; transition: opacity .4s; }
.chat .line.gap { margin-top: 14px; }
.chat .line.ag { color: var(--muted); }
.chat .line.ag .p { color: var(--muted); }
.chat .line.q .p { color: var(--a1); }
.chat .line.q { color: var(--term-ink); }
.chat .line.ok .p { color: var(--a4); }
.chat .line.ans { padding-left: 64px; }
.chat .line.hide { display: none; }
.chat .line.add, .chat .line.del, .chat .line.cmd, .chat .line.out { padding: 0 28px 0 64px; font-size: 19px; }
.chat .line.add { color: var(--good); }
.chat .line.add .p { color: var(--good); }
.chat .line.del { color: var(--a1); }
.chat .line.del .p { color: var(--a1); }
.chat .line.cmd { padding-left: 28px; padding-top: 6px; color: var(--term-ink); }
.chat .line.cmd .p { color: var(--a2); }
.chat .line.out { color: var(--muted); }
.chat .line.wait .p { color: var(--a3); }
.chat .line.wait.done .p { color: var(--a4); }
.chat .line .t { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.chat .line.doc { padding: 0 28px 0 64px; font-size: 19px; color: var(--term-ink); }
.chat .line.doc .p { color: var(--a2); }
.chat .line.doc .t { white-space: pre; }
.chat .line.doc.h { color: var(--a2); font-weight: 700; }

/* pasos del recorrido */
.walk-slide h2 { font-size: 46px; margin: 4px 0 20px; }
.stagger > * { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-16px); transition: opacity .35s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.6); transition-delay: calc(var(--i) * .18s + .25s); }
.on .stagger > * { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.ex { position: absolute; left: 72px; right: 72px; bottom: 40px; padding: 10px 0; }
.ex .viewport { height: 112px; }
.ex .line { font-size: 18px; padding: 2px 24px; }
.ex .line.ans { padding-left: 54px; }
.ex .line.add, .ex .line.del { padding-left: 54px; font-size: 16px; }
.ex .label { position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 10px; z-index: 1; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); border: 2px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 999px; }

.explore { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.25fr; gap: 30px; align-items: start; }
.explore .card { padding: 20px 26px; }
.explore h3 { margin: 0 0 14px; }
.explore ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.3; }
.explore .new { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.explore .old { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 24%, var(--card)); }

.design { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 506px 1fr; gap: 34px; align-items: start; }
.bp { position: relative; width: 506px; height: 316px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; background-color: #1c4f8c; background-image: linear-gradient(#ffffff1c 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff1c 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; }
.bp svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 500px; height: 310px; overflow: visible; }
.bp .layer { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .4s; }
.walk-slide[data-step="1"] .bp .l1, .walk-slide[data-step="2"] .bp .l2, .walk-slide[data-step="3"] .bp .l3, .walk-slide[data-step="4"] .bp .l3 { opacity: 1; }
.bp .ln { fill: none; stroke: #eaf2ff; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.bp .ln.thin { stroke-width: 6; opacity: .45; }
.bp .ln.arrow { stroke: var(--a3); stroke-width: 3; }
.bp .draw { stroke-dasharray: 100; stroke-dashoffset: 100; transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.2s ease-out; }
.walk-slide[data-step="1"] .l1 .draw, .walk-slide[data-step="2"] .l2 .draw, .walk-slide[data-step="3"] .l3 .draw, .walk-slide[data-step="4"] .l3 .draw { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
.bp .l1 .arrow, .bp .l3 .link { transition-delay: .9s; }
.bp .l3 .link + .link { transition-delay: 1.6s; }
.bp circle { fill: #eaf2ff; opacity: .6; }
.bp .hot { fill: var(--a3); opacity: .7; }
.bp .btn { fill: var(--a2); stroke: #eaf2ff; stroke-width: 3; }
.bp text { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 15px; fill: #eaf2ff; text-anchor: middle; }
.bp text.emo { font-size: 26px; }
.bp text.note { font-size: 13px; fill: #b8cdf0; }
.bp text.title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; text-anchor: start; }
.bp text.btntxt { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
.points { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.point { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px 1fr; gap: 2px 14px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.3; }
.point .ico { grid-row: span 2; font-size: 34px; text-align: center; }
.point b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; }
.point span:last-child { color: var(--muted); }

.document { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
.ddoc { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 18px 24px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; }
.ddoc .path { margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }
.ddoc .h { margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--a2); }
.ddoc .h.why { color: var(--a3); }
.ddoc i { height: 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 30%, transparent); }
.ddoc i:nth-of-type(even) { width: 70%; }
.dright { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; padding-top: 6px; }
.fate { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; font-size: 22px; }
.fate .gone { padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--muted); border: 2px dashed var(--muted); border-radius: 12px; }
.fate.on .gone { animation: gone .8s .7s forwards; }
@keyframes gone { to { opacity: .35; text-decoration: line-through; } }
.fate .stays { padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 35%, var(--card)); }
.readers .small { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.readers .stagger { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 24px; }
.loopback { align-self: flex-start; padding: 14px 22px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #111; background: var(--a3); }

.build { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 290px 60px 300px 60px 290px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; }
.ins, .outs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.chipc { padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 30%, var(--card)); }
.chipc.bump { animation: bump .35s ease-out; }
.outs .chipc { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.4); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 30%, var(--card)); transition: opacity .3s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8); }
.outs .chipc.on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.pipe { text-align: center; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); transition: color .3s; }
.pipe.live { color: var(--a3); animation: nudge .5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes nudge { 50% { transform: translateX(8px); } }
.agentbox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; }
.agentbox .mascot { --size: 110px; }
.agentbox .status { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; color: var(--muted); }
.agentbox .status .p { color: var(--a3); }
.agentbox.done .status { color: var(--ink); }
.agentbox.done .status .p { color: var(--good); }
.punch { margin-top: 30px; text-align: center; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); transition: opacity .45s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.4); }
.punch.show { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

/* ayudita */
.install { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 20px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--term-bg); color: var(--term-ink); margin-top: -8px; }
.flow { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 450px 1fr; gap: 40px; margin-top: 26px; height: 400px; }
.flow .term { font-size: 19px; height: 100%; }
.flow .term .line { min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 22px; }
.flow .term .msg { color: var(--a4); }
.browser { position: relative; background: var(--card); border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: visible; transform-origin: left center; }
.browser .chrome { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: var(--border); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); }
.browser .chrome i { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 25%, transparent); }
.browser .url { margin-left: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent); }
.browser .page { padding: 18px 26px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.75; }
.browser .page .h { font-weight: 700; color: var(--a2); }
.browser .page .ln { position: relative; border-radius: 6px; transition: background .4s; padding: 0 6px; margin: 0 -6px; }
.browser .page .ln.marked { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 55%, transparent); }
.browser .page .ln.fixed { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 30%, transparent); }
.browser .page .ln.add { display: none; color: var(--good); font-weight: 700; }
.browser .page .ln.add.show { display: block; animation: chipIn .4s both; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 22%, transparent); }
.browser .page { line-height: 1.6; }
.browser .send { position: absolute; right: 22px; bottom: 18px; padding: 10px 18px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--a2); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--line); }
.browser .send.press { animation: press .5s ease-out; }
@keyframes press { 40% { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--line); } }
.note { position: absolute; width: 190px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; background: var(--a3); color: #111; border: var(--border); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }

/* ctm */

.blk { padding: 12px 12px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; }

/* verificar */

.dbview .ghost b { display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; color: var(--a1); text-decoration: none; }
.dbview .dbok { margin-top: auto; padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #111; background: var(--good); border-radius: 10px; opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); transition: opacity .3s, transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.8); }
.dbview.ghosted .ghost, .dbview.done .dbok { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

/* verificar la pantalla */
.vflow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 540px 1fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 22px; height: 430px; }
.vflow .term { height: 100%; padding-bottom: 0; }

.vflow .chat .line.out { padding-left: 40px; }
.vbrowser { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.3); transition: opacity .4s, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.6); overflow: hidden; }

.app { position: relative; padding: 18px 22px; font-size: 22px; }

.pointer { position: absolute; left: 60%; top: 70%; z-index: 5; width: 30px; height: 30px; opacity: 0; transition: left .6s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1), top .6s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1), opacity .3s; }

<script>
const $ = (sel, root = document) => root.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = (sel, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)];
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

/* ───────────── Mascot ───────────── */

const EYES = {
  open: '<ellipse cx="38" cy="52" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><ellipse cx="62" cy="52" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="40" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="64" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/>',
  wide: '<circle cx="38" cy="51" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="62" cy="51" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="39" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="61" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/>',
  half: '<path d="M32 51 h12 M56 51 h12" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M33 52 q5 6 10 0 M57 52 q5 6 10 0" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M31 42 l12 3 M69 42 l-12 3" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  x: '<path d="M33 47 l10 10 M43 47 l-10 10 M57 47 l10 10 M67 47 l-10 10" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  happy: '<path d="M32 54 q6 -9 12 0 M56 54 q6 -9 12 0" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  odd: '<circle cx="38" cy="53" r="4" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="62" cy="50" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="61" cy="51" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M30 44 l14 -3 M55 36 l14 4" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
};

const MOUTH = {
  smile: '<path d="M42 64 Q50 73 58 64" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  grin: '<path d="M40 63 Q50 78 60 63 Z" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M45 69 Q50 73 55 69" fill="#ff7a93"/>',
  worried: '<path d="M43 69 Q50 63 57 69" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  flat: '<path d="M44 67 h12" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  wow: '<ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="4.5" ry="5.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/>',
  squiggle: '<path d="M40 68 q3 -4 6 0 t6 0 t6 0" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
};

const MOODS = {
  happy: { eyes: "open", mouth: "smile" },
  wave: { eyes: "happy", mouth: "grin", arm: true },
  joy: { eyes: "happy", mouth: "grin" },
  sweat: { eyes: "wide", mouth: "worried", drop: true },
  dizzy: { eyes: "x", mouth: "squiggle" },
  skeptic: { eyes: "half", mouth: "flat" },
  wow: { eyes: "wide", mouth: "wow" },
  confused: { eyes: "odd", mouth: "squiggle", q: true },
  frustrated: { eyes: "half", mouth: "worried", steam: true },
};

const mascotSVG = (mood) => {
  const m = MOODS[mood] || MOODS.happy;

  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="94" rx="30" ry="4" fill="#000" opacity=".12"/>
    ${m.arm ? '<path class="arm" d="M84 60 q14 -8 10 -26" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>' : ""}
    <path d="M50 12 C78 12 90 34 90 58 C90 80 74 90 50 90 C26 90 10 80 10 58 C10 34 22 12 50 12Z" fill="var(--mascot)" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="34" cy="28" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#fff" opacity=".45" transform="rotate(-25 34 28)"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="63" r="5" fill="#ff7a93" opacity=".45"/><circle cx="72" cy="63" r="5" fill="#ff7a93" opacity=".45"/>
    ${EYES[m.eyes]}${MOUTH[m.mouth]}
    ${m.q ? '<text class="qmark" x="74" y="12" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="var(--a1)" font-family="var(--font-display)">?</text>' : ""}
    ${m.steam ? '<path class="steam" d="M84 22 l8 -8 M90 32 l11 -3 M76 16 l2 -11" stroke="var(--a1)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>' : ""}
    ${m.drop ? '<path class="drop" d="M80 26 q-5 8 0 11 q5 -3 0 -11Z" fill="#6ec3ff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="1.5"/>' : ""}
  </svg>`;
};

const setMood = (el, mood) => {
  if (el == null || el.dataset.cur === mood) {
    return;
  }

  el.dataset.cur = mood;
  el.innerHTML = mascotSVG(mood);
};

const replay = (el, cls) => {
  el.classList.remove(cls);
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add(cls);
};

const confetti = (container, x, y, count = 28) => {
  const colors = ["--a1", "--a2", "--a3", "--a4"];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const c = document.createElement("div");
    c.className = "confetti";
    c.style.left = `${x}px`;
    c.style.top = `${y}px`;
    c.style.background = `var(${colors[i % colors.length]})`;
    c.style.setProperty("--dx", `${rand(-220, 220)}px`);
    c.style.setProperty("--dy", `${rand(-200, 160)}px`);
    c.style.setProperty("--rot", `${rand(-540, 540)}deg`);
    container.appendChild(c);
    setTimeout(() => c.remove(), 1500);
  }
};

/* ───────────── Track ───────────── */

const buildTrack = (track) => {
  const stops = track.dataset.stops.split("|");

  track.innerHTML = stops.map((label, i) => {
    const finish = track.hasAttribute("data-finish") && i === stops.length - 1;

    return `<div class="stop${finish ? " finish" : ""}" style="animation-delay: ${i * .18}s; z-index: ${stops.length - i}"><div class="dot"></div><span>${label}</span></div>`;
  }).join("") + '<div class="mascot rider" data-mood="happy"></div>';
};

const setTrack = (track, pos) => {
  const stops = $$(".stop", track);
  const rider = $(".rider", track);

  stops.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle("lit", i <= pos));

  const target = stops[Math.max(pos, 0)];
  rider.style.left = `${target.offsetLeft + target.offsetWidth / 2}px`;
  rider.style.opacity = pos < 0 ? 0 : 1;
};

const redraw = (track) => replay(track, "draw");

/* ───────────── Slide hooks ───────────── */

let run = 0;
let visit = 0;

const typeInto = async (el, text, speed, token, clock = () => run) => {
  el.textContent = "";

  for (const ch of text) {
    if (token !== clock()) {
      return;
    }

    el.textContent += ch;
    await sleep(speed);
  }
};

// One slide per stop of the route: the rider hops in from the previous stop and the example chat plays on the last click
const walkStep = (pos, extra = () => {}) => (step, el, ctx) => {
  const track = $(".track", el);
  const rider = $(".rider", track);
  const last = stepsOf(el);

  if (ctx.entered) {
    const token = visit;

    rider.style.transition = "none";
    setTrack(track, ctx.forward ? pos - 1 : pos);
    void rider.offsetWidth;
    rider.style.transition = "";
    setMood(rider, "happy");

    if (ctx.forward) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (token === visit) {
          replay(rider, "jump");
          setTrack(track, pos);
        }
      }, 500);
    }
  }

  playChat(step === last ? 1 : 0, el, ctx.forward && step === last);
  extra(step, el, ctx);
};

const hooks = {
  portada: (step, el, { entered }) => {
    const m = $(".mascot", el);

    if (!entered) {
      return;
    }

    // Tied to the visit, not the render: the re-render after the web fonts load must not cut the typing
    const token = visit;
    m.classList.remove("enter");
    m.style.opacity = 0;

    typeInto($(".typed", el), "Planificar y Revisar", 70, token, () => visit).then(() => {
      if (token !== visit) {
        return;
      }

      m.style.opacity = 1;
      m.classList.add("enter");
    });
  },

  hoy: (step, el, { entered }) => {
    const track = $(".track", el);

    if (entered) {
      redraw(track);
    }

    setTrack(track, 0);
  },

  aprendimos: async (step, el, { forward }) => {
    const bar = $(".bar", el);
    const segs = $$(".seg", bar);
    const pct = $(".pct", el);
    const checks = $$(".checks span", el);
    const qs = $(".qs", el);
    const m = $(".mascot", el);
    const token = run;

    const light = (n) => segs.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle("lit", i < n));

    const reset = (n, p) => {
      bar.classList.remove("chaos");
      segs.forEach((seg) => { seg.classList.remove("fall"); seg.style.transform = ""; seg.style.transitionDuration = ""; seg.style.transitionDelay = ""; });
      qs.innerHTML = "";
      light(n);
      pct.textContent = `${p}%`;
    };

    const spawnQ = (animate) => {
      const q = document.createElement("span");
      q.textContent = "?";
      q.style.left = `${rand(52, 88)}%`;
      q.style.top = `${rand(40, 78)}%`;
      q.style.fontSize = `${rand(44, 110)}px`;
      q.style.animationDelay = `${animate ? 0 : -1}s, ${rand(0, 1.5)}s`;
      qs.appendChild(q);
    };

    const scatter = (animate) => segs.forEach((seg) => {
      seg.classList.add("fall");
      seg.style.transitionDelay = animate ? `${rand(0, .35)}s` : "0s";
      seg.style.transitionDuration = animate ? "" : "0s";
      seg.style.transform = `translate(${rand(-60, 60)}px, ${rand(220, 420)}px) rotate(${rand(-160, 160)}deg)`;
    });

    if (step === 0) {
      reset(0, 0);
      checks.forEach((c) => c.classList.remove("on"));
      setMood(m, "happy");
      return;
    }

    if (step === 1) {
      reset(0, 0);
      setMood(m, "joy");

      if (!forward) {
        light(15);
        pct.textContent = "78%";
        checks.forEach((c) => c.classList.add("on"));
        return;
      }

      checks.forEach((c) => c.classList.remove("on"));

      for (let p = 0; p <= 78; p += 1) {
        if (token !== run) {
          return;
        }

        light(Math.floor(p / 5));
        pct.textContent = `${p}%`;
        checks.forEach((c, i) => c.classList.toggle("on", p >= 12 + i * 20));
        await sleep(p > 60 ? 45 : 22);
      }

      return;
    }

    if (!forward) {
      reset(0, 0);
      checks.forEach((c) => c.classList.add("on"));

/* ───────────── Review loops ───────────── */

// Verifying and reviewing can both send you back to the code: one arc from each, deeper when the loop is longer
const drawLoop = (loop) => {
  const [code, ...finders] = $$(".blk", loop);
  const svg = $("svg", loop);
  const backs = $$(".back", svg);
  const top = Math.max(...[code, ...finders].map((b) => b.offsetTop + b.offsetHeight)) + 6;
  const depth = loop.closest(".after") == null ? 30 : 14;
  const to = code.offsetLeft + code.offsetWidth / 2;

  svg.setAttribute("width", loop.offsetWidth);
  svg.setAttribute("height", top + depth * finders.length + 10);

  finders.forEach((b, i) => {
    const from = b.offsetLeft + b.offsetWidth / 2;
    const d = depth * (i + 1);
    backs[i].setAttribute("d", `M${from} ${top} C${from} ${top + d}, ${to} ${top + d}, ${to} ${top + 4}`);
  });

  $(".head", svg).setAttribute("d", `M${to - 9} ${top + 12} L${to} ${top} L${to + 9} ${top + 12}`);
};

/* ───────────── Walking the steps ───────────── */

// Forward most of the time, a frustrated step back now and then, then the finish line
const STEPS_WALK = [0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 4, 5, 6];
const DEMO_WALK = [0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3];

const walkSteps = async (track, token, walk) => {
  const rider = $(".rider", track);
  const finish = walk[walk.length - 1];

  await sleep(1600);

  while (token === visit) {
    for (let i = 0; i < walk.length; i += 1) {
      if (token !== visit) {
        return;
      }

      const pos = walk[i];
      const backNext = walk[i + 1] != null && walk[i + 1] < pos;
      const wentBack = i > 0 && pos < walk[i - 1];

      if (i > 0) {
        replay(rider, "jump");
      }

      setTrack(track, pos);
      setMood(rider, wentBack ? "sweat" : pos === finish ? "joy" : "happy");

      if (backNext) {
        await sleep(700);
        setMood(rider, "frustrated");
        await sleep(900);
      } else {
        await sleep(pos === finish ? 300 : 1100);
      }
    }

    if (token !== visit) {
      return;
    }

    setMood(rider, "wave");
    confetti(track, rider.offsetLeft, 20, 36);
    await sleep(2600);
  }
};

const CHAT_MARK = { me: ">", ans: ">", ag: "·", q: "?", ok: "✓", doc: "│", add: "+", del: "-", cmd: "$", out: "", wait: "⠋" };
const SPIN = "⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏";

const esc = (s) => s.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/"/g, """).replace(/</g, "<");

const buildChat = (feed) => {
  feed.innerHTML = CHATS[feed.dataset.chat].flatMap((group, g) => group.map(([kind, text, extra = {}], i) => {
    const cls = ["line", kind === "ans" ? "me ans" : kind, text.startsWith("#") ? "h" : "", i === 0 && g > 0 ? "gap" : ""].join(" ");
    const tag = extra.tag == null ? "" : `<span class="tag">${extra.tag}</span>`;
    const data = [
      `data-group="${g}"`,
      `data-text="${esc(text)}"`,
      extra.done == null ? "" : `data-done="${esc(extra.done)}" data-ms="${extra.ms}"`,
      extra.act == null ? "" : `data-act="${extra.act}"`,
    ].join(" ");

    return `<div class="${cls}" ${data}><span class="p">${CHAT_MARK[kind]}</span><span class="t"></span>${tag}</div>`;
  })).join("");
};

const settleLine = (l) => {
  $(".t", l).textContent = l.dataset.done ?? l.dataset.text;

  if (l.classList.contains("wait")) {
    $(".p", l).textContent = "✓";
    l.classList.add("done");
  }
};

const PAUSE = { q: 900, doc: 140, add: 220, del: 220, out: 260 };

// Plays the group of the current click; everything before it is rendered settled, actions included
const playChat = async (step, el, forward, act = async () => {}) => {
  const viewport = $(".viewport", el);
  const feed = $(".feed", viewport);
  const lines = $$(".line", feed);
  const token = run;
  const current = step - 1;

  const scroll = () => {
    const last = lines.filter((l) => !l.classList.contains("hide")).pop();
    const bottom = last == null ? 0 : last.offsetTop + last.offsetHeight;
    feed.style.transform = `translateY(${Math.min(0, viewport.clientHeight - bottom - 12)}px)`;
  };

  lines.forEach((l) => {
    const g = Number(l.dataset.group);
    l.classList.toggle("hide", g > current || (forward && g === current));
    l.classList.remove("done");
    $(".p", l).innerHTML = CHAT_MARK[l.classList[1]];
    settleLine(l);
  });

  for (const l of lines.filter((x) => !x.classList.contains("hide") && x.dataset.act != null)) {
    await act(l.dataset.act, false);
  }

  scroll();

  if (!forward || step === 0) {
    return;
  }

  for (const l of lines.filter((x) => Number(x.dataset.group) === current)) {
    if (token !== run) {
      return;
    }

    const typed = l.classList.contains("me") || l.classList.contains("cmd");

    if (typed) {
      $(".t", l).textContent = "";
    } else if (l.classList.contains("wait")) {
      $(".t", l).textContent = l.dataset.text;
    }

    l.classList.remove("hide");
    scroll();

    if (typed) {
      const speed = l.classList.contains("cmd") ? 14 : l.classList.contains("ans") ? 40 : 22;
      await typeInto($(".t", l), l.dataset.text, speed, token);
      await sleep(250);
    } else if (l.classList.contains("wait")) {
      const end = Date.now() + Number(l.dataset.ms);

      for (let f = 0; Date.now() < end; f += 1) {
        if (token !== run) {
          return;
        }

        $(".p", l).textContent = SPIN[f % SPIN.length];
        await sleep(80);
      }

      settleLine(l);
      await sleep(300);
    } else {
      await sleep(PAUSE[l.classList[1]] ?? 450);
    }

    if (token !== run) {
      return;
    }

    if (l.dataset.act != null) {
      await act(l.dataset.act, true);
      await sleep(400);
    }
  }
};

/* ───────────── Timer ───────────── */

let timerStart = null;
let timerTick = null;

const startTimer = (el) => {
  if (timerStart != null) {
    return;
  }

  timerStart = Date.now();
  clearInterval(timerTick);

  timerTick = setInterval(() => {
    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - timerStart) / 1000);
    el.textContent = `⏱ ${String(Math.floor(s / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }, 250);
};

$(".timer").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  timerStart = null;
  e.currentTarget.textContent = "⏱ 00:00";
  startTimer(e.currentTarget);
});

/* ───────────── Slider ───────────── */

// Rework falls hard with the first decisions and flattens out; understanding climbs fast and saturates
const CURVES = {
  retrabajo: (v) => 1 / (1 + .9 * v),
  entender: (v) => 1.2 * v / (v + 2),
};

const curveX = (v) => 56 + v * 44;
const curveY = (y) => 206 - y * 186;

const buildCurve = (svg) => {
  const f = CURVES[svg.dataset.f];
  const d = Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${curveX(i / 10).toFixed(1)} ${curveY(f(i / 10)).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");

  svg.innerHTML = `<path class="axis" d="M56 6 V206 H504" />
    <text x="70" y="14">${svg.dataset.label}</text>
    <text class="xlbl" x="504" y="238">tiempo diseñando →</text>
    <path class="guide" />
    <path class="fn" d="${d}" />
    <g class="pt"><circle r="11" /></g>`;
};

const setCurve = (svg, v) => {
  const x = curveX(v);
  const y = curveY(CURVES[svg.dataset.f](v));

  $(".pt", svg).style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)`;
  $(".guide", svg).style.d = `path("M56 ${y} H${x} V206")`;
};


const range = $(".design-range");

const renderSlider = (animate) => {
  const v = Number(range.value);
  const yours = $(".chips.yours");
  const prevYours = yours.childElementCount;

  yours.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: v }, (_, i) => `<div class="chip yes" style="${!animate || i < prevYours ? "animation: none" : ""}">✓</div>`).join("");
  $(".chips.agents").innerHTML = Array.from({ length: 10 - v }, () => '<div class="chip no" style="animation: none">?</div>').join("");
  setMood($(".slider-slide .mascot"), v >= 8 ? "joy" : v >= 4 ? "happy" : "skeptic");
  $$(".curve").forEach((svg) => setCurve(svg, v));
};

range.addEventListener("input", () => renderSlider(true));
range.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => (e.key === "Escape" ? range.blur() : e.stopPropagation()));

/* ───────────── Titles ───────────── */

// Titles stay on one line: shrink the ones that would overflow the slide width
const fitTitles = () => $$(".slide h2").forEach((h) => {
  h.style.fontSize = "";

  let size = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(h).fontSize);

  while (h.scrollWidth > h.clientWidth && size > 30) {
    size -= 2;
    h.style.fontSize = `${size}px`;
  }
});

/* ───────────── Navigation ───────────── */

const slides = $$(".slide");
let idx = 0;
let step = 0;

// Inside kurasu the deck runs in a sandboxed iframe: the web moves it with kurasu:go messages and owns the
// navigation, so the deck leaves the keys, the address bar and its own HUD alone.
const embedded = window.parent !== window;

const stepsOf = (s) => Number(s.dataset.steps || Math.max(0, ...$$("[data-step]", s).map((e) => Number(e.dataset.step))));

const show = (entered, forward) => {
  run += 1;

  if (entered) {
    visit += 1;
  }

  slides.forEach((s, i) => {
    s.classList.toggle("active", i === idx);
    s.classList.toggle("past", i < idx);
  });

  const slide = slides[idx];
  slide.dataset.step = step;
  $$("[data-step]", slide).forEach((e) => e.classList.toggle("on", Number(e.dataset.step) <= step));

  const hook = hooks[slide.dataset.id];

  if (hook != null) {
    hook(step, slide, { entered, forward });
  }

  $(".count").textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
  $(".stepdots").innerHTML = Array.from({ length: stepsOf(slide) }, (_, i) => `<i class="${i < step ? "on" : ""}"></i>`).join("");
  if (!embedded) {
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.search}#${idx + 1}${step > 0 ? `.${step}` : ""}`);
  }
};

const next = () => {
  if (step < stepsOf(slides[idx])) {
    step += 1;
    show(false, true);
  } else if (idx < slides.length - 1) {
    idx += 1;
    step = 0;
    show(true, true);
  }
};

const prev = () => {
  if (step > 0) {
    step -= 1;
    show(false, false);
  } else if (idx > 0) {
    idx -= 1;
    step = stepsOf(slides[idx]);
    show(true, false);
  }
};

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (embedded) {
    return;
  }

  if (["ArrowRight", " ", "PageDown", "Enter"].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    next();
  } else if (["ArrowLeft", "PageUp", "Backspace"].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    prev();
  } else if (e.key === "f" || e.key === "F") {
    document.fullscreenElement == null ? document.documentElement.requestFullscreen() : document.exitFullscreen();
  } else if (e.key === "h" || e.key === "H") {
    $("#hud").classList.toggle("hidden");
  }
});

const fit = () => {
  const k = Math.min(innerWidth / 1280, innerHeight / 720);
  $("#deck").style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${k})`;
};

addEventListener("resize", fit);

/* ───────────── Init ───────────── */

$(".bar").innerHTML = '<div class="seg"></div>'.repeat(20);
$$(".track").forEach(buildTrack);
$$(".chat .feed").forEach(buildChat);
$$(".curve").forEach(buildCurve);
$$(".mascot").forEach((m) => setMood(m, m.dataset.mood));
renderSlider(false);
fit();

fitTitles();

const [hashSlide, hashStep] = location.hash.slice(1).split(".").map(Number);
idx = Math.min(Math.max((hashSlide || 1) - 1, 0), slides.length - 1);
step = Math.min(hashStep || 0, stepsOf(slides[idx]));
show(true, step === 0);

document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
  fitTitles();
  show(false, false);
});

/* ───────────── kurasu ───────────── */

// kurasu counts slides and steps from 1 and gives a slide without inner steps one step, so the deck's
// step 0 is kurasu's step 1.
if (embedded) {
  $("#hud").classList.add("hidden");

  window.parent.postMessage({
    type: "kurasu:manifest",
    slides: slides.map((s) => ({ steps: stepsOf(s) + 1 })),
  }, "*");

  addEventListener("message", (e) => {
    const go = e.data;

    if (e.source !== window.parent || go?.type !== "kurasu:go" || !Number.isInteger(go.slide) || !Number.isInteger(go.step)) {
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = Math.min(Math.max(go.slide - 1, 0), slides.length - 1);
    const nextStep = Math.min(Math.max(go.step - 1, 0), stepsOf(slides[nextIdx]));
    const forward = nextIdx > idx || (nextIdx === idx && nextStep >= step);
    const entered = nextIdx !== idx;

    if (!entered && nextStep === step) {
      return;
    }

    idx = nextIdx;
    step = nextStep;
    show(entered, forward);
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

# Session 5 — exploration decisions

Exploration of the harness hour of the course's last class (Session 5 combined with Session 6's open-weight block), on the canvas `canvas/explore.tldr.json`.

## Settled

   "1. The harness part of the last class lasts about one hour at most. The project demos and the open-weight models block are already settled and stay out of this exploration.\n2. The course closing happens in this last class, outside the harness hour, and stays out of this exploration.\n3. The extension exercise stays out of this exploration.\n4. The order of the harness hour and the open-weight block doesn't shape this exploration.\n5. propuesta-mcp/ is set aside for now; whether any of it enters the harness hour isn't being decided yet.\n6. How Pi 1 ships MCP (exposure, code mode) isn't included in the harness hour.\n7. The BeerJS talk's slides are the base for the harness hour, laid out as a storyboard to reorganize.\n8. Pi-durable comes in as an alternative to pi-coding-agent: the differences in architecture and their trade-offs. The tentacles project is a reference for how it's used, never named on the slides.\n9. Slide 2 (About me) is dropped: the room already knows who you are.\n10. Slide 8's table shows MCP and code mode as built into both, in the rows right after Skills.\n11. Slide 9 draws Pi's four packages in slide 3's stacked structure, one box per package, without repeating slide 3's items.\n12. Slide 10 (the lifecycle) stays, but it was hard to follow; it gets reworked later, when the new deck is prototyped after the storyboard pass.\n13. The talk's demo code moves into the course repo, next to Session 5's slides.\n14. Slides 13 (Conclusions), 14 (Questions) and 15 (Sources) are dropped.\n15. Pi-durable gets its own slides after the last storyboard slide, framed as \"what happens when you want the agent to do more than a coding agent does today\": long runs and durability, multiplayer, several environments.\n16. Then an architecture slide for pi-durable that shows the parts of its harness more clearly than the research diagram, marking what is the same as the coding agent (extensions, tools, the session).\n17. After the architecture slide, one slide each, in this order: storage (the session saved anywhere), execution environments (run in different places, move between them), durability (a JSONL file vs pi-durable's approach, the phases that make each action resumable), multiplayer (follow a session, watch its changes, steer it, send it messages). Documents are left out.\n    – Storage was added later (also as a fourth \"what if\" on PD1); the order goes from the simplest and most predictable to the most interesting, to keep the room engaged."

## Storyboard as settled (talk slides → deck order)

1. Portada · 3. Harnesses (four layers) · 4. Harness examples · 5. Coding agents · 6. What is Pi? · 7. Same philosophy (VS Code / Vim) · 8. The difference in numbers (MCP and code mode ✓ both, after Skills) · 9. Architecture (four packages stacked like slide 3, name left, description right) · 10. Extensions: lifecycle (rework while prototyping) · 11. Programmatic API · 12. Demo → Demo 1 mascot, Demo 2 subagents (3 commits), Demo 3 Pi in the browser
→ PD1 Beyond the coding agent (four "what ifs": storage anywhere, other environments, long runs and crashes, several people steering)
→ PD2 pi-durable architecture (pi-ai at the bottom, the harness as the frame: conversations · tools · extensions [same as the coding agent] / tasks · execution env / storage [new]; clients on top)
→ PD3 Storage → PD4 Execution environments → PD5 Durability (effect sandwich; pi.tool and pi.generation phases vs the JSONL file) → PD6 Multiplayer (watch, steer, follow-up, late joiner)

Dropped: 2 About me, 13 Conclusions, 14 Questions, 15 Sources.

- **Demo code (decision 13)**: target folder (e.g. `sessions/session-5/demos/`), which `subagents.ts` (197 lines in `04_Archive/pi-talk`, 280 in `04_Archive/Projects/pi-talk`), and when to copy it. Don't copy `.claude/settings.local.json`.
- **Decision 6 vs decision 10**: slide 8's table now names MCP and code mode as built into both; does decision 6 still mean "no slide on how they work"?
- Asserted, not verified: Claude Code has code mode (your statement for slide 8).

# Session 5 — exploration decisions

Exploration of the harness hour of the course's last class (Session 5 combined with Session 6's open-weight block), on the canvas `canvas/explore.tldr.json`.

## Settled

   "1. The harness part of the last class lasts about one hour at most. The project demos and the open-weight models block are already settled and stay out of this exploration.\n2. The course closing happens in this last class, outside the harness hour, and stays out of this exploration.\n3. The extension exercise stays out of this exploration.\n4. The order of the harness hour and the open-weight block doesn't shape this exploration.\n5. propuesta-mcp/ is set aside for now; whether any of it enters the harness hour isn't being decided yet.\n6. How Pi 1 ships MCP (exposure, code mode) isn't included in the harness hour.\n7. The BeerJS talk's slides are the base for the harness hour, laid out as a storyboard to reorganize.\n8. Pi-durable comes in as an alternative to pi-coding-agent: the differences in architecture and their trade-offs. The tentacles project is a reference for how it's used, never named on the slides.\n9. Slide 2 (About me) is dropped: the room already knows who you are.\n10. Slide 8's table shows MCP and code mode as built into both, in the rows right after Skills.\n11. Slide 9 draws Pi's four packages in slide 3's stacked structure, one box per package, without repeating slide 3's items.\n12. Slide 10 (the lifecycle) stays, but it was hard to follow; it gets reworked later, when the new deck is prototyped after the storyboard pass.\n13. The talk's demo code moves into the course repo, next to Session 5's slides.\n14. Slides 13 (Conclusions), 14 (Questions) and 15 (Sources) are dropped.\n15. Pi-durable gets its own slides after the last storyboard slide, framed as \"what happens when you want the agent to do more than a coding agent does today\": long runs and durability, multiplayer, several environments.\n16. Then an architecture slide for pi-durable that shows the parts of its harness more clearly than the research diagram, marking what is the same as the coding agent (extensions, tools, the session).\n17. After the architecture slide, one slide each, in this order: storage (the session saved anywhere), execution environments (run in different places, move between them), durability (a JSONL file vs pi-durable's approach, the phases that make each action resumable), multiplayer (follow a session, watch its changes, steer it, send it messages). Documents are left out.\n    – Storage was added later (also as a fourth \"what if\" on PD1); the order goes from the simplest and most predictable to the most interesting, to keep the room engaged."

## Storyboard as settled (talk slides → deck order)

1. Portada · 3. Harnesses (four layers) · 4. Harness examples · 5. Coding agents · 6. What is Pi? · 7. Same philosophy (VS Code / Vim) · 8. The difference in numbers (MCP and code mode ✓ both, after Skills) · 9. Architecture (four packages stacked like slide 3, name left, description right) · 10. Extensions: lifecycle (rework while prototyping) · 11. Programmatic API · 12. Demo → Demo 1 mascot, Demo 2 subagents (3 commits), Demo 3 Pi in the browser
→ PD1 Beyond the coding agent (four "what ifs": storage anywhere, other environments, long runs and crashes, several people steering)
→ PD2 pi-durable architecture (pi-ai at the bottom, the harness as the frame: conversations · tools · extensions [same as the coding agent] / tasks · execution env / storage [new]; clients on top)
→ PD3 Storage → PD4 Execution environments → PD5 Durability (effect sandwich; pi.tool and pi.generation phases vs the JSONL file) → PD6 Multiplayer (watch, steer, follow-up, late joiner)

Dropped: 2 About me, 13 Conclusions, 14 Questions, 15 Sources.

## Still open

- **Demo code (decision 13)**: target folder (e.g. `sessions/session-5/demos/`), which `subagents.ts` (197 lines in `04_Archive/pi-talk`, 280 in `04_Archive/Projects/pi-talk`), and when to copy it. Don't copy `.claude/settings.local.json`.
- **Decision 6 vs decision 10**: slide 8's table now names MCP and code mode as built into both; does decision 6 still mean "no slide on how they work"?
- Asserted, not verified: Claude Code has code mode (your statement for slide 8).

<result># Session 5 — findings

Each fact with its source and whether it was verified or only asserted by the source.

## Course sources

- Session 5 INSTRUCTOR.md plans 2 h 30: 60 min demos + 87 min after them (opening 3, harness 10, loop 14, tree 7, break 5, three ways 13, compaction 7, open your session + homework 10, run modes 4, security 9, closing 5). Verified (read the file).
- Vault `session-5.md` plans a 2 h skeleton with a 35-min in-class hands-on. Verified.
- `pi-talk.md` plans the BeerJS talk at ~31 min (28 content + 3 Q&A; demos 3, 6, 5 min). Verified. How long it ran on the day isn't recorded.
- Talk demo-2 `subagents.ts`: 197 lines (`04_Archive/pi-talk`), 280 lines (`04_Archive/Projects/pi-talk`). Verified (wc). Demo 1 has only PROMPT.md; demo 3 is a Vite app. Verified (ls).
- `propuesta-mcp/`: 11 slides by Diego, commit 4f46077 (2026-10-24); MCP layers, code mode and its sandbox, FastMCP. Verified (read the HTML, git log).
- Pi 1 ships MCP with `exposure` (codemode default); Session 3 taught it. Asserted by the INSTRUCTOR's pendientes.
- Earendil's announcement says pi-durable "does not replace the Pi coding agent". Asserted by the source (researcher).

## pi-durable (researcher subagents reading Earendil's README, spec.md, announcement and pi-durable-cloudflare; no trial run)

- v1.6.0 (2026-11-20), MIT, ~15k lines, "Experimental. The API changes without notice between releases."
- Depends on pi-ai, not pi-agent-core: own Harness, task scheduler, storage layer.
- Storage backends: memory, IndexedDB, SQLite, JSONL, Cloudflare Durable Object; one process owns a storage, others attach read-only; JSONL keeps history in memory, README recommends SQLite for long runs; conformance suite for custom backends.
- Commits are atomic over entries, task records and documents (spec §1, §10). Every effect is an "effect sandwich": commit intent, perform, commit outcome (spec §5.2).
- `pi.tool` phases: call → execute (recovery only) → result; parked while waiting. On reopen in execute: rerun only if `replay: "safe"`, otherwise an `interrupted` error result with committed partial output (spec §8.4, README).
- `pi.generation` phases: prepare, request, retry, poll, tools, finish, drain, afterTools, yield. After a close the request is re-sent; after a crash the partial becomes an aborted entry, the attempt counts as failed and is retried per policy (spec §8.3).
- `env(target)` builds the ExecutionEnv per tool call from {conversationId, cwd, read}; NodeExecutionEnv; pi-env RemoteExecutionEnv over SSH to a Rust daemon. Switching env mid-conversation follows by construction; docs describe one container per conversation.
- `conversation.watch()` gives a view then commit ops; late joiners start from the current view, nothing replayed; `submit` with `whenBusy: steer | followUp | reject` (default followUp); `requestId` makes it exactly-once.
- Cloudflare sample: one SQLite-backed Durable Object per session, DO alarm → onWake/resume, hibernating WebSockets; no container in the sample.
- Pi coding agent sessions: JSONL under `~/.pi/agent/sessions/`, id/parentId tree, one line appended per entry (appendFileSync); docs say nothing about resuming a turn cut by a crash. Read in docs and source by the researcher.

## tentacles (code scout over ~/workspace/asermax/tentacles; reference only, not for slides)

- One Durable Object per session runs `Harness.open` over DO SQLite; the DO alarm calls wake; tools via CodingTools and code mode, files in DO SQLite, exec on an isolate shell or a container; reads replay-safe, writes/exec not; parent plugin over HTTP + one WebSocket per session; questions survive evictions.
- Costs its docs name: nothing runs locally, skills fixed at spawn, container cold start ~1–3 s, npm install 11.4 s vs 4.8 s, processes lost on container stop.
</result>
</event>

Arquitectura

pi-tui
UI de terminal: editor, temas, atajos. Lo que ve el usuario.
pi-agent-core
Agente genérico: loop, bus de eventos, ejecución de tools. No es solo para código.
pi-coding-agent
CLI, sesiones, extensiones, tools de código (read, write, edit, bash).
pi-ai
API unificada de LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local, cualquier proveedor. La base.

Extensiones: la vida de una sesión

session_startse crea o se abre la sesión
→
resources_discoverlas extensiones suman skills, prompts y temas
→
agent loop ↻un turno del agente, que se repite con cada mensaje: lo abrimos en la próxima
→
session_shutdownse cierra la sesión
mientras vive, hooks antes de cada cambio de sesión
session_before_switch/new, /resume
session_before_fork/fork
session_before_compactantes de compactar el contexto
session_before_tree/tree: saltar a otra rama

La extensión se entera antes de que pase: puede frenarlo o cambiar cómo se hace.

Extensiones: el agent loop

input
before_agent_start
🔌 punto de extensióninyectar o modificar el system prompt
context
🔌 punto de extensiónmodificar los mensajes que van al modelo
LLM call
tool_call
🔌 punto de extensiónbloquear o modificar argumentos. Permisos, plan mode: { block: true }
tool_result
🔌 punto de extensiónmodificar lo que recibe el modelo
↻vuelve al LLM hasta que no pida más tools
agent_end
listo
pi.on(evento, (e, ctx) => …) → bloquear · modificar · inyectar ctx.ui → notify · confirm · select · custom

modelo, tools y razonamiento, sin reiniciar

tools, comandos, atajos, flags, proveedores y cómo se ve cada mensaje

pi.sendMessage(mensaje)
pi.sendUserMessage(texto)
// steer:    mientras el modelo responde
// followUp: cuando termina
// nextTurn: en el próximo turno
mandarle mensajes al agente, o como si los escribiera el usuario
${BAR('session.ts')} 
ctx.newSession()
ctx.fork(…)
ctx.navigateTree(…)
ctx.compact()

/* ───────────── Palette (pop noche) ───────────── */

:root {
  --radius: 20px;

:root {
  --bg: #15153a;

  --good: #06d6a0;

  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;

  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --term-bg: #05051a;

}

/* ───────────── Stage ───────────── */

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  transition: background .4s, color .4s;
}

body {
  background-image: var(--bg-pattern);
  background-size: var(--bg-size);
}

#deck {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 1280px;
  height: 720px;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.slide {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: 50px 72px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(60px) scale(.98);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.2);
}

.slide.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: none;
}

.slide.past { transform: translateX(-60px) scale(.98); }

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}

h1 { font-size: 104px; }
h2 { font-size: var(--title-size); white-space: nowrap; }
h3 { font-size: 30px; }

p { margin: 0; }

.big { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.25; }
.mid { font-size: 30px; }
.small { font-size: 22px; color: var(--muted); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.center { text-align: center; }
.hl { color: var(--a1); }

.card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 22px 26px;
}

.slide > .mascot { position: absolute; right: 80px; bottom: 50px; --size: 130px; }

/* ───────────── Fragments ───────────── */

[data-step] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(18px);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.4);
}

[data-step].on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.f-drop { transform: translateY(-120px) rotate(-8deg); }
.f-drop.on { transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); }
.f-flip { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(-95deg); transform-origin: left center; }
.f-flip.on { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(0); }
.f-pop { transform: scale(.3); }
.f-pop.on { transform: scale(1); }

/* ───────────── Mascot ───────────── */

.mascot {
  width: var(--size, 120px);
  height: var(--size, 120px);
  display: inline-block;
}

.mascot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; animation: bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot.jump svg { animation: jump .6s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .6s infinite; }
.mascot.bigjump svg { animation: bigjump .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .9s infinite; }
.mascot.shake svg { animation: shake .12s linear infinite; }

@keyframes bob { 50% { transform: translateY(-5px) scaleY(1.02); } }
@keyframes jump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.15, .85); } 50% { transform: translateY(-90px) scale(.92, 1.1) rotate(-6deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.12, .88); } 100% { transform: none; } }
@keyframes bigjump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.2, .8); } 45% { transform: translateY(-150px) rotate(-200deg); } 70% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(-360deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.15, .85) rotate(-360deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-2deg); } 75% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(2deg); } }
@keyframes wave { 50% { transform: rotate(-22deg); } }

.mascot .arm { transform-origin: 84px 60px; animation: wave .5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot .drop { animation: drip 1.1s ease-in infinite; }
.mascot .qmark { animation: qbob 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 80px 4px; }
.mascot .steam { animation: steam .35s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes qbob { to { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(12deg); } }
@keyframes steam { to { opacity: .4; transform: translate(2px, -2px); } }
@keyframes drip { 0% { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 0; } 30% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(14px); opacity: 0; } }

.confetti { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 18px; border-radius: 3px; pointer-events: none; animation: confetti 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2, .6, .4, 1) forwards; }
@keyframes confetti { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)); opacity: 0; } }

/* bloques en fila */
.blk { padding: 14px 18px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }
.blk small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); white-space: normal; max-width: 240px; }
.blk.rev { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 40%, var(--card)); }
.blk.calm { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 35%, var(--card)); }
.blk.des { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 35%, var(--card)); }
.arrow { padding-top: 14px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
.stg { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); transition: opacity .35s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.6); transition-delay: calc(var(--i) * .16s); }
.on .stg { opacity: 1; transform: none; }


/* portada */
.cover { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; }
.cover .kicker { font-size: 30px; color: var(--muted); }
.cover h1 { font-size: 170px; margin: 0; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
.cover .subt { margin: 6px 0 26px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 58px; letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 66px; }
.cover .cursor { display: inline-block; width: .45em; height: .85em; background: var(--a1); vertical-align: -.06em; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
.cover .mascot { position: absolute; right: 110px; top: 90px; --size: 200px; }
.cover .mascot.enter { animation: dropIn .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) both; }
@keyframes dropIn { from { transform: translateY(-600px) rotate(-20deg); } to { transform: none; } }

.lead { margin: -8px 0 20px; font-size: 25px; color: var(--muted); }
.lead b { color: var(--ink); }
.punch-step { margin-top: 22px; }
@keyframes loopflow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -19; } }

/* ventanas */
.win { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.win .bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #ffffff14; border-bottom: 2px solid #fdf6e322; }
.win .bar i { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5f57; }
.win .bar i:nth-child(2) { background: #febc2e; }
.win .bar i:nth-child(3) { background: #28c840; }
.win .bar .title { margin-left: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); }
.win .body { flex: 1; padding: 16px 20px; }
.win.dark .body { background: var(--term-bg); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-ligatures: none; }
.shot { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); border: 1px dashed var(--muted); border-radius: 6px; }

/* harness: capas */
.stack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 820px 240px; gap: 12px 26px; margin-top: 8px; }
.layer { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 16px 24px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; }
.layer small { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.layer.ui { grid-row: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 34%, var(--card)); }
.layer.loop { grid-row: 2; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); }
.trio { grid-row: 3; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.trio .layer { flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 26%, var(--card)); }
.layer.llm { grid-row: 4; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); }
.layer.llm small { color: #15153a; opacity: .7; }
.brace { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 4; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.brace .bar { align-self: stretch; width: 26px; border: 5px solid var(--a3); border-left: none; border-radius: 0 18px 18px 0; }
.brace b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 40px; color: var(--a3); }
.side-llm { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; align-self: center; font-size: 20px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ejemplos */
.wins3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 30px; margin-top: 18px; }
.wins3 .win { height: 400px; }
.wins3 .body { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.wins3 .cap { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.bub { max-width: 80%; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 14px; }
.bub.me { align-self: flex-end; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 45%, var(--card)); }
.bub.ai { align-self: flex-start; background: #ffffff12; }
.chatbox { margin-top: auto; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); border: 2px solid #fdf6e344; border-radius: 999px; }
.lov { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.lov .side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.lov .side i { height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff12; }
.lov .prev { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #fdf6e3; }
.lov .prev .hero { height: 90px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--a1), var(--a3)); }
.lov .prev i { height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #15153a33; }
.lov .prev i:nth-of-type(2) { width: 70%; }
.lov .prev .btn { width: 90px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--a2); }
.tline { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tline .p { color: var(--a3); }
.tline .ok { color: var(--good); }
.tline .tool { color: var(--a2); }

/* agentes de código */
.dirs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1.15fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 30px; align-items: start; }
.dirs .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 22px; }
.dirs .prod { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 26px 0 14px; }
.dirs .prod .ico { font-size: 64px; line-height: 1; }
.dirs .prod b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 36px; }
.dirs .prod span { font-size: 19px; color: var(--muted); }
.ls { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.6; }
.ls span { display: block; }
.ls .more { color: var(--a3); }

/* qué es pi */
.author { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin: -10px 0 20px; padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 20px; border: 2px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted); }
.author b { color: var(--ink); }
.pi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 500px 1fr; gap: 26px; }
.pi-term .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; font-size: 20px; }
.tools4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.tools4 span { padding: 14px 0; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; color: #15153a; background: var(--a4); border-radius: 10px; }
.meter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.meter .lbl { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 18px; color: var(--muted); }
.meter .lbl b { color: var(--a3); }
.meter .ctx { position: relative; height: 24px; border: 2px solid #fdf6e3aa; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.meter .ctx i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 0; background: var(--a3); transition: width 1s cubic-bezier(.3, .9, .4, 1) .3s; }
.meter .ctx.cc i { background: var(--a1); }
.on .meter .ctx i { width: var(--w); }
.pi-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.pi-cards .card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 16px 20px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; }
.pi-cards .card .ico { grid-row: span 2; font-size: 40px; }
.pi-cards .card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 26px; }
.pi-cards .card span.d { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted); }
.pi-cards .card .viz { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(1) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 22%, var(--card)); }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(3) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.provs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; width: 190px; justify-content: flex-end; }
.provs i { padding: 2px 8px; font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--a2); border-radius: 6px; }

/* misma filosofía */
.philo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 40px; margin-top: 16px; }
.philo .head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; border-bottom: none; }
