<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Pi: el agente que se construye solo</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ───────────── Palette (pop noche) ───────────── */

:root {
  --radius: 20px;
  --title-size: 58px;
}

:root {
  --bg: #15153a;
  --bg-pattern: radial-gradient(#ffffff16 2px, transparent 2px);
  --bg-size: 28px 28px;
  --ink: #fdf6e3;
  --muted: #a9a6d6;
  --card: #262660;
  --line: #fdf6e3;
  --border: 3px solid #fdf6e3;
  --shadow: 8px 8px 0 #05051a;
  --a1: #ff5c8a;
  --a2: #5b8cff;
  --a3: #ffd166;
  --a4: #06d6a0;
  --good: #06d6a0;
  --bad: #ff5c5c;
  --mascot: #ffd166;
  --mascot-ink: #15153a;
  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --term-bg: #05051a;
  --term-ink: #fdf6e3;
}

/* ───────────── Stage ───────────── */

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  transition: background .4s, color .4s;
}

body {
  background-image: var(--bg-pattern);
  background-size: var(--bg-size);
}

#deck {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 1280px;
  height: 720px;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.slide {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: 50px 72px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(60px) scale(.98);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.2);
}

.slide.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: none;
}

.slide.past { transform: translateX(-60px) scale(.98); }

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}

h1 { font-size: 104px; }
h2 { font-size: var(--title-size); white-space: nowrap; }
h3 { font-size: 30px; }

p { margin: 0; }

.big { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.25; }
.mid { font-size: 30px; }
.small { font-size: 22px; color: var(--muted); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.center { text-align: center; }
.hl { color: var(--a1); }

.card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 22px 26px;
}

.slide > .mascot { position: absolute; right: 80px; bottom: 50px; --size: 130px; }

/* ───────────── Fragments ───────────── */

[data-step] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(18px);
  transition: opacity .45s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.4);
}

[data-step].on { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.f-drop { transform: translateY(-120px) rotate(-8deg); }
.f-drop.on { transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); }
.f-flip { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(-95deg); transform-origin: left center; }
.f-flip.on { transform: perspective(900px) rotateY(0); }
.f-pop { transform: scale(.3); }
.f-pop.on { transform: scale(1); }

/* ───────────── Mascot ───────────── */

.mascot {
  width: var(--size, 120px);
  height: var(--size, 120px);
  display: inline-block;
}

.mascot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; animation: bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot.jump svg { animation: jump .6s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .6s infinite; }
.mascot.bigjump svg { animation: bigjump .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) 1, bob 2.4s ease-in-out .9s infinite; }
.mascot.shake svg { animation: shake .12s linear infinite; }

@keyframes bob { 50% { transform: translateY(-5px) scaleY(1.02); } }
@keyframes jump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.15, .85); } 50% { transform: translateY(-90px) scale(.92, 1.1) rotate(-6deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.12, .88); } 100% { transform: none; } }
@keyframes bigjump { 0% { transform: none; } 15% { transform: scale(1.2, .8); } 45% { transform: translateY(-150px) rotate(-200deg); } 70% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(-360deg); } 85% { transform: scale(1.15, .85) rotate(-360deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-2deg); } 75% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(2deg); } }
@keyframes wave { 50% { transform: rotate(-22deg); } }

.mascot .arm { transform-origin: 84px 60px; animation: wave .5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mascot .drop { animation: drip 1.1s ease-in infinite; }
.mascot .qmark { animation: qbob 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 80px 4px; }
.mascot .steam { animation: steam .35s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes qbob { to { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(12deg); } }
@keyframes steam { to { opacity: .4; transform: translate(2px, -2px); } }
@keyframes drip { 0% { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 0; } 30% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(14px); opacity: 0; } }

.confetti { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 18px; border-radius: 3px; pointer-events: none; animation: confetti 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2, .6, .4, 1) forwards; }
@keyframes confetti { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)); opacity: 0; } }

/* bloques en fila */
.blk { padding: 14px 18px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }
.blk small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); white-space: normal; max-width: 240px; }
.blk.rev { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 40%, var(--card)); }
.blk.calm { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 35%, var(--card)); }
.blk.des { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 35%, var(--card)); }
.arrow { padding-top: 14px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
.stg { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.6); transition: opacity .35s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.6); transition-delay: calc(var(--i) * .16s); }
.on .stg { opacity: 1; transform: none; }


/* portada */
.cover { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; }
.cover .kicker { font-size: 30px; color: var(--muted); }
.cover h1 { font-size: 170px; margin: 0; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
.cover .subt { margin: 6px 0 26px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 58px; letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 66px; }
.cover .cursor { display: inline-block; width: .45em; height: .85em; background: var(--a1); vertical-align: -.06em; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
.cover .mascot { position: absolute; right: 110px; top: 90px; --size: 200px; }
.cover .mascot.enter { animation: dropIn .9s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) both; }
@keyframes dropIn { from { transform: translateY(-600px) rotate(-20deg); } to { transform: none; } }

.lead { margin: -8px 0 20px; font-size: 25px; color: var(--muted); }
.lead b { color: var(--ink); }
.punch-step { margin-top: 22px; }
@keyframes loopflow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -19; } }

/* ventanas */
.win { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.win .bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #ffffff14; border-bottom: 2px solid #fdf6e322; }
.win .bar i { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5f57; }
.win .bar i:nth-child(2) { background: #febc2e; }
.win .bar i:nth-child(3) { background: #28c840; }
.win .bar .title { margin-left: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); }
.win .body { flex: 1; padding: 16px 20px; }
.win.dark .body { background: var(--term-bg); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-ligatures: none; }
.shot { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); border: 1px dashed var(--muted); border-radius: 6px; }

/* harness: capas */
.stack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 820px 240px; gap: 12px 26px; margin-top: 8px; }
.layer { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 16px 24px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; }
.layer small { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.layer.ui { grid-row: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 34%, var(--card)); }
.layer.loop { grid-row: 2; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); }
.trio { grid-row: 3; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.trio .layer { flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 26%, var(--card)); }
.layer.llm { grid-row: 4; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); }
.layer.llm small { color: #15153a; opacity: .7; }
.brace { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 4; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.brace .bar { align-self: stretch; width: 26px; border: 5px solid var(--a3); border-left: none; border-radius: 0 18px 18px 0; }
.brace b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 40px; color: var(--a3); }
.side-llm { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; align-self: center; font-size: 20px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ejemplos */
.wins3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 30px; margin-top: 18px; }
.wins3 .win { height: 400px; }
.wins3 .body { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.wins3 .cap { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.bub { max-width: 80%; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 14px; }
.bub.me { align-self: flex-end; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 45%, var(--card)); }
.bub.ai { align-self: flex-start; background: #ffffff12; }
.chatbox { margin-top: auto; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); border: 2px solid #fdf6e344; border-radius: 999px; }
.lov { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.lov .side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.lov .side i { height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff12; }
.lov .prev { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #fdf6e3; }
.lov .prev .hero { height: 90px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--a1), var(--a3)); }
.lov .prev i { height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #15153a33; }
.lov .prev i:nth-of-type(2) { width: 70%; }
.lov .prev .btn { width: 90px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--a2); }
.tline { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tline .p { color: var(--a3); }
.tline .ok { color: var(--good); }
.tline .tool { color: var(--a2); }

/* agentes de código */
.dirs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1.15fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 30px; align-items: start; }
.dirs .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 22px; }
.dirs .prod { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 26px 0 14px; }
.dirs .prod .ico { font-size: 64px; line-height: 1; }
.dirs .prod b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 36px; }
.dirs .prod span { font-size: 19px; color: var(--muted); }
.ls { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.6; }
.ls span { display: block; }
.ls .more { color: var(--a3); }

/* qué es pi */
.author { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin: -10px 0 20px; padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 20px; border: 2px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted); }
.author b { color: var(--ink); }
.pi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 500px 1fr; gap: 26px; }
.pi-term .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; font-size: 20px; }
.tools4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.tools4 span { padding: 14px 0; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; color: #15153a; background: var(--a4); border-radius: 10px; }
.meter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.meter .lbl { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 18px; color: var(--muted); }
.meter .lbl b { color: var(--a3); }
.meter .ctx { position: relative; height: 24px; border: 2px solid #fdf6e3aa; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.meter .ctx i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 0; background: var(--a3); transition: width 1s cubic-bezier(.3, .9, .4, 1) .3s; }
.meter .ctx.cc i { background: var(--a1); }
.meter.on .ctx i { width: var(--w); }
.pi-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.pi-cards .card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 16px 20px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; }
.pi-cards .card .ico { grid-row: span 2; font-size: 40px; }
.pi-cards .card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 26px; }
.pi-cards .card span.d { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted); }
.pi-cards .card .viz { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(1) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 22%, var(--card)); }
.pi-cards .card:nth-child(3) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.provs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; width: 190px; justify-content: flex-end; }
.provs i { padding: 2px 8px; font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--a2); border-radius: 6px; }

/* misma filosofía */
.philo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 40px; margin-top: 16px; }
.philo .head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; border-bottom: none; }
.philo .head h3 { margin: 0; }
.philo .head span { font-size: 21px; color: var(--muted); }
.philo .col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.philo .col.full .head, .philo .col.full .cells { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 22%, var(--card)); }
.philo .col.min .head, .philo .col.min .cells { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 20%, var(--card)); }
.philo .cells { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; min-height: 330px; padding: 10px 24px 26px; border: var(--border); border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.philo .chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 18px 22px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--card); border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; }
.philo .chip .ico { font-size: 40px; }
.philo .chip small { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.philo .eq { align-self: center; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }

/* planilla */
.sheet { width: 980px; margin: 4px auto 0; }
.sheet .body { padding: 0; background: #fdf6e3; color: #15153a; }
.sheet table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 21px; }
.sheet td, .sheet th { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #15153a2e; }
.sheet .colhdr th { height: 26px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: #15153a99; background: #e8e1cc; }
.sheet .rn { width: 44px; padding: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #15153a99; text-align: center; background: #e8e1cc; }
.sheet .hdr td { font-weight: 700; background: #ffd16655; }
.sheet td.v { width: 220px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; }
.sheet tr[data-step] td { transition: background .6s; }
.sheet tr.cur td:not(.rn) { background: #5b8cff22; }
.yes { color: #079c75; }
.no { color: #e0336a; }
.sheet .foot td { height: 44px; font-size: 18px; font-style: italic; color: #15153acc; }

/* arquitectura de pi */
.pkgs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr; gap: 14px 18px; margin-top: 18px; }
.pkg { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 18px 22px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; min-height: 92px; }
.pkg.name { justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 27px; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 700; }
.pkg.desc { font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.3; }
.pkg.desc b { color: var(--a3); }
.pkg.tui { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 34%, var(--card)); }
.pkg.core { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); }
.pkg.coding { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 26%, var(--card)); }
.pkg.ai { color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); }
.pkg.desc { background: var(--card); }

/* ciclo de vida: sesión */
.life { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; margin-top: 34px; }
.life .arrow { align-self: center; padding: 0; font-size: 34px; }
.mom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 245px; padding: 16px 18px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; }
.mom b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 18px; }
.mom span { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--muted); }
.mom.big { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); border-style: dashed; }
.mom.big b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; }
.mom.cur { outline: 4px solid var(--a3); outline-offset: 4px; }
.hooks { position: relative; margin-top: 46px; padding: 22px 24px 20px; border: 3px dashed var(--a3); border-radius: 18px; }
.hooks .lbl { position: absolute; top: -18px; left: 22px; padding: 2px 12px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); border-radius: 8px; }
.hooks .row4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
.hooks .hk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--a3); border-radius: 12px; }
.hooks .hk b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 17px; }
.hooks .hk span { font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); }
.hooks p { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 20px; }

/* ciclo de vida: agent loop */
.loopwrap { position: relative; width: 1136px; height: 430px; margin-top: 4px; }
.loopwrap svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: visible; }
.loopwrap .ln { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
.loopwrap .ln.back { stroke: var(--a4); stroke-dasharray: 10 9; animation: loopflow 1.4s linear infinite; }
.loopwrap marker path { fill: var(--ink); }
.loopwrap marker#hg path { fill: var(--a4); }
.node { position: absolute; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 64px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; transition: opacity .45s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.4), outline-color .3s; outline: 4px solid transparent; outline-offset: 4px; }
.node.ext { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); }
.node.llmn { color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); }
.node.end { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 30%, var(--card)); }
.node.cur { outline-color: var(--a3); }
.tag { position: absolute; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 16%, var(--bg)); border: 2px solid var(--a1); border-radius: 10px; }
.tag b { display: block; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--a1); }
.tag code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; color: var(--a3); }
.loopnote { position: absolute; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; text-align: center; color: var(--a4); }
.loopnote .big { font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; }
.elabel { position: absolute; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.onapi { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 48px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 19px; white-space: nowrap; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); }
.onapi code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-ligatures: none; color: var(--a3); }

/* api programática */
.code4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px 26px; margin-top: 4px; }
.code4 .win { height: 252px; }
.code4 .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 14px 20px; }
.code4 pre { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-ligatures: none; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; }
.code4 .fn { color: var(--a2); }
.code4 .obj { color: var(--a1); }
.code4 .s { color: var(--a4); }
.code4 .c { color: var(--muted); }
.code4 .what { margin-top: auto; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; color: var(--a3); }

/* demo */
.demos { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; margin-top: 10px; }
.demo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr; gap: 6px 22px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 26px; }
.demo .n { grid-row: span 2; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--a3); }
.demo h3 { margin: 0; }
.demo h3 code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 24px; color: var(--a3); }
.demo .chain { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 19px; color: var(--muted); }
.demo .chain span.c { padding: 3px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); border: 2px solid #fdf6e366; border-radius: 8px; }
.demo .chain .sep { margin: 0 6px; color: var(--a1); }
.demo:nth-child(1) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 22%, var(--card)); }
.demo:nth-child(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.demo:nth-child(3) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.demo-slide > .mascot { right: 70px; top: 40px; bottom: auto; --size: 110px; }

/* PD1: ¿y si...? */
.whatif { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px 30px; height: 470px; margin-top: 10px; }
.whatif .center { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 24px; text-align: center; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.whatif .center .ico { font-size: 60px; line-height: 1; }
.whatif .center h3 { margin: 0; }
.whatif .center p { font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--muted); }
.whatif .q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; padding: 20px 24px; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
.whatif .q .ico { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; }
.whatif .q small { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--a3); }
.whatif .q:nth-of-type(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.whatif .q:nth-of-type(3) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 24%, var(--card)); }
.whatif .q:nth-of-type(4) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 24%, var(--card)); }
.whatif .q:nth-of-type(5) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 18%, var(--card)); }

/* PD2: arquitectura de pi-durable */
.dur { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 860px 1fr; gap: 0 26px; align-items: start; }
.dur .col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.clients { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.clients .cl { padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); }
.clients code { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; color: var(--a3); }
.frame { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 34px 20px 20px; border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 20px; background: #ffffff08; }
.frame .lbl { position: absolute; top: -20px; left: 22px; padding: 2px 14px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #15153a; background: var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; }
.frame .r { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.frame .r3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.frame .r2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
.part { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; border: 3px solid; border-radius: 12px; }
.part small { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.part.same { border-color: var(--a4); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 20%, var(--card)); }
.part.new { border-color: var(--a1); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 22%, var(--card)); }
.base { padding: 16px 22px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #05051a; }
.base small { margin-left: 16px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 400; }
.legend { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; margin-top: 70px; font-size: 20px; }
.legend span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.legend i { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 3px solid; border-radius: 6px; }
.legend .same i { border-color: var(--a4); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 20%, var(--card)); }
.legend .new i { border-color: var(--a1); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 22%, var(--card)); }

/* PD3: storage */
.store { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 290px 150px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 4px; }
.hbox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 22px; font-size: 20px; border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 18px; background: #ffffff08; }
.hbox b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; }
.hbox code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--a3); }
.flow { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
.flow .ar { font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink); }
.backends { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.be { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 2px 14px; padding: 9px 18px; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 18%, var(--card)); }
.be .ico { grid-row: span 2; font-size: 30px; }
.be b { font-size: 22px; }
.be span { font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); }
.contrast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin-top: 22px; padding: 14px 22px; font-size: 22px; border: 3px dashed var(--a4); border-radius: 14px; }
.contrast code { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--a3); }

/* PD4: entornos */
.envs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 330px 260px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 22px; margin-top: 16px; }
.machine { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 30px 20px 20px; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 20px; transition: border-color .5s; }
.machine .lbl { position: absolute; top: -16px; left: 18px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); border-radius: 8px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .5s; }
.machine.away { border-color: var(--a3); border-style: dashed; }
.machine.away .lbl { opacity: 1; }
.machine .call { padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 17px; border: 2px solid #fdf6e366; border-radius: 10px; }
.envfn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 18px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.envfn code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; color: var(--a3); }
.envfn span { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--muted); }
.targets { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.tg { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 20%, var(--card)); }
.tg .ico { font-size: 34px; }
.tg small { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.arrowcol { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font-size: 40px; color: var(--muted); }

/* PD5: durabilidad */
.dur2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 430px 1fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 4px; }
.jsonl .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; }
.jsonl .ln2 { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff0d; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.jsonl .ln2.cut { color: var(--bad); background: #ff5c5c22; }
.jsonl .txt { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink); }
.jsonl .txt span { color: var(--muted); }
.sandwich { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.sandwich h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; }
.sw { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 22px; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; border: var(--border); }
.sw .n { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; color: var(--a3); }
.sw small { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.sw.bread { border-radius: 30px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a3) 30%, var(--card)); }
.sw.fill { border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 30%, var(--card)); }
.crash { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; border: 3px dashed var(--bad); border-radius: 14px; }
.crash b { color: var(--bad); }
.crash code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 17px; color: var(--a3); }

/* PD6: multiplayer */
.multi { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px 1fr 300px; gap: 24px; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; }
.multi .side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; }
.cli { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 18px; font-size: 19px; }
.cli h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; }
.cli code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--a3); }
.cli:nth-child(1) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 22%, var(--card)); }
.cli:nth-child(2) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a2) 26%, var(--card)); }
.cli.late { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a4) 22%, var(--card)); }
.convo .body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-height: 330px; }
.msg { padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff10; }
.msg b { display: block; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.msg.steer { border: 2px solid var(--a1); }
.msg.steer b { color: var(--a1); }
.msg.fu { border: 2px dashed var(--a2); }
.msg.fu b { color: var(--a2); }
.msg.busy::after { content: " ▍"; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
.tie { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 22px; }
.tie code { padding: 3px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 19px; color: #15153a; background: var(--a3); border-radius: 8px; }

/* ───────────── HUD ───────────── */

#hud {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font: 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--muted);
  opacity: .25;
  transition: opacity .3s;
  z-index: 60;
}

#hud:hover { opacity: 1; }
#hud.hidden { display: none; }
#hud .stepdots i { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin: 0 2px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: .3; }
#hud .stepdots i.on { opacity: 1; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="deck">

  <!-- 1 · Portada -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="portada">
    <div class="cover">
      <div class="kicker">Última clase · el harness</div>
      <h1><span class="typed"></span></h1>
      <div class="subt"><span class="typed2"></span><span class="cursor"></span></div>
      <p class="mid">De Vibe Coding a Agentic Engineering · FaMAF</p>
      <div class="mascot" data-mood="wave"></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <!-- Notas: arrancamos con el nombre: Pi es un coding agent open source con un núcleo mínimo. "Se construye solo" porque le pedís una capacidad nueva y lee su propio código para escribirse la extensión. La hora no es para vender Pi: es para entender qué es un harness, y Pi nos sirve de espécimen porque es chico y se puede abrir entero. -->

  <!-- 2 · Harnesses -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="harness">
    <h2>Harnesses</h2>
    <div class="stack">
      <div class="layer ui" data-step="3">Interfaz <small>chat · terminal · web</small></div>
      <div class="layer loop" data-step="2">Agent loop <small>pensar → actuar → observar</small></div>
      <div class="trio" data-step="1">
        <div class="layer">Tools <small>archivos, web, comandos</small></div>
        <div class="layer">Memoria <small>conversación, estado</small></div>
        <div class="layer">Contexto <small>proyecto, reglas</small></div>
      </div>
      <div class="layer llm">LLM <small>predice el próximo token</small></div>
      <div class="brace" data-step="4"><span class="bar"></span><b>harness</b></div>
      <div class="side-llm">el modelo</div>
    </div>
    <p class="mid center punch-step" data-step="4">Mismo modelo, distinto harness: <span class="hl">otro producto</span>.</p>
  </section>
  <!-- Notas: un LLM solo predice tokens: recibe texto y devuelve texto, no puede leer un archivo ni correr un comando. El harness (arnés) es lo que lo conecta al mundo: le da tools, memoria, contexto, un loop que repite pensar, actuar y observar, y una interfaz. Construir de abajo hacia arriba. Todos los productos de IA son un modelo más un harness, y la diferencia entre productos está en el harness, no en el modelo. -->

  <!-- 3 · Ejemplos de harnesses -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="ejemplos">
    <h2>Ejemplos de harnesses</h2>
    <div class="wins3">
      <div class="f-drop" data-step="1" style="--r: -2deg">

          <div class="body">

            <div class="bub ai">Podés usar <span class="mono">lista[::-1]</span> o <span class="mono">reversed(lista)</span>…</div>
            <div class="bub me">¿Y sin crear otra?</div>
            <div class="chatbox">Escribí un mensaje…</div>
            <span class="shot">captura</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="cap">chat web</p>
      </div>
      <div class="f-drop" data-step="2" style="--r: 1deg">
        <div class="win"><div class="bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span class="title">lovable.app</span></div>
          <div class="body">
            <div class="lov">
              <div class="side"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
              <div class="prev"><div class="hero"></div><i></i><i></i><div class="btn"></div></div>
            </div>
            <span class="shot">captura</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="cap">vibe coding visual</p>

  </section>
  <!-- Notas: tres harnesses distintos que pueden tener el mismo modelo abajo. ChatGPT: chat web con pocas tools. Lovable: arma apps con una vista previa, sin que toques código. Un coding agent en terminal: lee y edita tus archivos y corre comandos en tu máquina. El harness que elegís define qué podés hacer. -->

  <!-- 4 · Agentes de código -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="agentes">
    <h2>Agentes de código</h2>
    <div class="dirs">
      <div class="win f-pop" data-step="1"><div class="bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span class="title">anthropic/</span></div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <!-- Notas: preguntar quiénes usaron alguno. Los dos grandes primero, después la carpeta de otros. No profundizar: es solo el mapa para ubicar a Pi en la próxima slide. -->

  <!-- 5 · ¿Qué es Pi? -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="quees">
    <h2>¿Qué es Pi?</h2>
    <div class="author">un coding agent open source de <b>Mario Zechner</b> (@badlogic)</div>

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pi-cards">
        <div class="card f-flip" data-step="3"><span class="ico">🔌</span><h3>Multi-proveedor</h3><span class="d">cualquier modelo, sin atarte a una empresa</span><span class="viz provs"><i>OpenAI</i><i>Anthropic</i><i>Google</i><i>local</i></span></div>
        <div class="card f-flip" data-step="4"><span class="ico">🔓</span><h3>Sin sistema de permisos</h3><span class="d">si necesitás límites, containerizá</span><span class="viz" style="font-size: 30px">📦</span></div>
        <div class="card f-flip" data-step="5"><span class="ico">🌳</span><h3>Sesiones en árbol</h3><span class="d">forkear desde cualquier punto y volver</span>
          <svg class="viz" width="120" height="60" viewBox="0 0 120 60"><path d="M6 30 H114 M40 30 Q50 30 56 12 H96 M70 30 Q80 30 86 50 H110" fill="none" stroke="var(--a4)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="6" cy="30" r="5" fill="var(--a4)"/><circle cx="40" cy="30" r="5" fill="var(--a4)"/><circle cx="70" cy="30" r="5" fill="var(--a4)"/></svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <!-- Notas: cuatro tools (read, write, edit, bash) y un system prompt de menos de mil tokens. Habla con cualquier proveedor. No tiene sistema de permisos: corre con los permisos de tu usuario, y si necesitás límites, lo metés en un contenedor. Las sesiones son un árbol: podés volver a cualquier mensaje, abrir una rama y explorar sin perder la historia. Mario Zechner está metido en el open source hace mucho y da muy buenas charlas. No profundizar en cada punto: solo plantarlos. -->

  <!-- 7 · La diferencia en números -->
  <section class="slide" data-id="numeros">
    <h2>La diferencia en números</h2>
    <div class="win sheet"><div class="bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span class="title">comparativa.xlsx</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <table>
          <tr class="colhdr"><th class="rn"></th><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th></tr>

        </div>

      <div class="card cli late" data-step="3"><h3>🙋 Llega tarde</h3><span>recibe la vista actual y después cada commit</span><code>watch() → vista + commits</code><span>nada se re-reproduce</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tie" data-step="4">Los mismos modos que vimos en la API de Pi: <code>steer</code><code>followUp</code><code>nextTurn</code></div>
  </section>
  <!-- Notas: una sola conversación y varios clientes. A manda un steer: entra mientras el agente está trabajando. B manda un follow-up: queda para cuando termine. Alguien que se engancha tarde llama a watch(): recibe la vista actual y después cada commit; no se le re-reproduce la historia. Son los mismos modos de entrega que vimos en la API programática del coding agent (steer, followUp, nextTurn), ahora entre personas distintas. -->

</div>

<div id="hud">
  <div><span class="count"></span>   <span class="stepdots"></span></div>
  <div>← → navegar · F pantalla completa · H ocultar</div>
</div>

<script>
const $ = (sel, root = document) => root.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = (sel, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)];
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

/* ───────────── Mascot ───────────── */

const EYES = {
  open: '<ellipse cx="38" cy="52" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><ellipse cx="62" cy="52" rx="5" ry="6.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="40" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="64" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/>',
  wide: '<circle cx="38" cy="51" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="62" cy="51" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="39" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="61" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/>',
  half: '<path d="M32 51 h12 M56 51 h12" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M33 52 q5 6 10 0 M57 52 q5 6 10 0" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M31 42 l12 3 M69 42 l-12 3" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  x: '<path d="M33 47 l10 10 M43 47 l-10 10 M57 47 l10 10 M67 47 l-10 10" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  happy: '<path d="M32 54 q6 -9 12 0 M56 54 q6 -9 12 0" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  odd: '<circle cx="38" cy="53" r="4" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><circle cx="62" cy="50" r="8" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="61" cy="51" r="3.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M30 44 l14 -3 M55 36 l14 4" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
};

const MOUTH = {
  smile: '<path d="M42 64 Q50 73 58 64" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  grin: '<path d="M40 63 Q50 78 60 63 Z" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/><path d="M45 69 Q50 73 55 69" fill="#ff7a93"/>',
  worried: '<path d="M43 69 Q50 63 57 69" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  flat: '<path d="M44 67 h12" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
  wow: '<ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="4.5" ry="5.5" fill="var(--mascot-ink)"/>',
  squiggle: '<path d="M40 68 q3 -4 6 0 t6 0 t6 0" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
};

const MOODS = {
  happy: { eyes: "open", mouth: "smile" },
  wave: { eyes: "happy", mouth: "grin", arm: true },
  joy: { eyes: "happy", mouth: "grin" },
  sweat: { eyes: "wide", mouth: "worried", drop: true },
  dizzy: { eyes: "x", mouth: "squiggle" },
  skeptic: { eyes: "half", mouth: "flat" },
  wow: { eyes: "wide", mouth: "wow" },
  confused: { eyes: "odd", mouth: "squiggle", q: true },
  frustrated: { eyes: "half", mouth: "worried", steam: true },
};

const mascotSVG = (mood) => {
  const m = MOODS[mood] || MOODS.happy;

  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="94" rx="30" ry="4" fill="#000" opacity=".12"/>
    ${m.arm ? '<path class="arm" d="M84 60 q14 -8 10 -26" fill="none" stroke="var(--mascot)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>' : ""}
    <path d="M50 12 C78 12 90 34 90 58 C90 80 74 90 50 90 C26 90 10 80 10 58 C10 34 22 12 50 12Z" fill="var(--mascot)" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="34" cy="28" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#fff" opacity=".45" transform="rotate(-25 34 28)"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="63" r="5" fill="#ff7a93" opacity=".45"/><circle cx="72" cy="63" r="5" fill="#ff7a93" opacity=".45"/>
    ${EYES[m.eyes]}${MOUTH[m.mouth]}
    ${m.q ? '<text class="qmark" x="74" y="12" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="var(--a1)" font-family="var(--font-display)">?</text>' : ""}
    ${m.steam ? '<path class="steam" d="M84 22 l8 -8 M90 32 l11 -3 M76 16 l2 -11" stroke="var(--a1)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>' : ""}
    ${m.drop ? '<path class="drop" d="M80 26 q-5 8 0 11 q5 -3 0 -11Z" fill="#6ec3ff" stroke="var(--mascot-ink)" stroke-width="1.5"/>' : ""}
  </svg>`;
};

const setMood = (el, mood) => {
  if (el == null || el.dataset.cur === mood) {
    return;
  }

  el.dataset.cur = mood;
  el.innerHTML = mascotSVG(mood);
};

const replay = (el, cls) => {
  el.classList.remove(cls);
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add(cls);
};

const confetti = (container, x, y, count = 28) => {
  const colors = ["--a1", "--a2", "--a3", "--a4"];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const c = document.createElement("div");
    c.className = "confetti";
    c.style.left = `${x}px`;
    c.style.top = `${y}px`;
    c.style.background = `var(${colors[i % colors.length]})`;
    c.style.setProperty("--dx", `${rand(-220, 220)}px`);
    c.style.setProperty("--dy", `${rand(-200, 160)}px`);
    c.style.setProperty("--rot", `${rand(-540, 540)}deg`);
    container.appendChild(c);
    setTimeout(() => c.remove(), 1500);
  }
};

/* ───────────── Slide hooks ───────────── */

let run = 0;
let visit = 0;

const typeInto = async (el, text, speed, token, clock = () => run) => {
  el.textContent = "";

  for (const ch of text) {
    if (token !== clock()) {
      return;
    }

    el.textContent += ch;
    await sleep(speed);
  }
};


const hooks = {
  portada: (step, el, { entered }) => {
    const m = $(".mascot", el);

    if (!entered) {
      return;
    }

    // Tied to the visit, not the render: the re-render after the web fonts load must not cut the typing
    const token = visit;
    m.classList.remove("enter");
    m.style.opacity = 0;
    $(".typed2", el).textContent = "";

    typeInto($(".typed", el), "Pi:", 110, token, () => visit)
      .then(() => typeInto($(".typed2", el), "el agente que se construye solo", 55, token, () => visit))
      .then(() => {
        if (token !== visit) {
          return;
        }

        m.style.opacity = 1;
        m.classList.add("enter");
      });
  },

  demo: (step, el) => setMood($(".mascot", el), step >= 3 ? "wow" : "joy"),

  entornos: (step, el) => $(".machine", el).classList.toggle("away", step >= 3),
};

/* ───────────── Titles ───────────── */

// Titles stay on one line: shrink the ones that would overflow the slide width
const fitTitles = () => $$(".slide h2").forEach((h) => {
  h.style.fontSize = "";

  let size = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(h).fontSize);

  while (h.scrollWidth > h.clientWidth && size > 30) {
    size -= 2;
    h.style.fontSize = `${size}px`;
  }
});

/* ───────────── Navigation ───────────── */

const slides = $$(".slide");
let idx = 0;
let step = 0;

// Inside kurasu the deck runs in a sandboxed iframe: the web moves it with kurasu:go messages and owns the
// navigation, so the deck leaves the keys, the address bar and its own HUD alone. Other iframes (a review tool's
// preview, for instance) send no kurasu:go, so the deck keeps its own controls until the first one arrives.
const framed = window.parent !== window;
let embedded = false;

const stepsOf = (s) => Number(s.dataset.steps || Math.max(0, ...$$("[data-step]", s).map((e) => Number(e.dataset.step))));

const show = (entered, forward) => {
  run += 1;

  if (entered) {
    visit += 1;
  }

  slides.forEach((s, i) => {
    s.classList.toggle("active", i === idx);
    s.classList.toggle("past", i < idx);
  });

  const slide = slides[idx];
  slide.dataset.step = step;
  $$("[data-step]", slide).forEach((e) => e.classList.toggle("on", Number(e.dataset.step) <= step));
  $$("[data-step]", slide).forEach((e) => e.classList.toggle("cur", Number(e.dataset.step) === step));

  const hook = hooks[slide.dataset.id];

  if (hook != null) {
    hook(step, slide, { entered, forward });
  }

  $(".count").textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
  $(".stepdots").innerHTML = Array.from({ length: stepsOf(slide) }, (_, i) => `<i class="${i < step ? "on" : ""}"></i>`).join("");
  if (!embedded) {
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.search}#${idx + 1}${step > 0 ? `.${step}` : ""}`);
  }
};

const next = () => {
  if (step < stepsOf(slides[idx])) {
    step += 1;
    show(false, true);
  } else if (idx < slides.length - 1) {
    idx += 1;
    step = 0;
    show(true, true);
  }
};

const prev = () => {
  if (step > 0) {
    step -= 1;
    show(false, false);
  } else if (idx > 0) {
    idx -= 1;
    step = stepsOf(slides[idx]);
    show(true, false);
  }
};

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (embedded) {
    return;
  }

  if (["ArrowRight", " ", "PageDown", "Enter"].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    next();
  } else if (["ArrowLeft", "PageUp", "Backspace"].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    prev();
  } else if (e.key === "f" || e.key === "F") {
    document.fullscreenElement == null ? document.documentElement.requestFullscreen() : document.exitFullscreen();
  } else if (e.key === "h" || e.key === "H") {
    $("#hud").classList.toggle("hidden");
  }
});

const fit = () => {
  const k = Math.min(innerWidth / 1280, innerHeight / 720);
  $("#deck").style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${k})`;
};

addEventListener("resize", fit);

/* ───────────── Init ───────────── */

$$(".mascot").forEach((m) => setMood(m, m.dataset.mood));
fit();

fitTitles();

const [hashSlide, hashStep] = location.hash.slice(1).split(".").map(Number);
idx = Math.min(Math.max((hashSlide || 1) - 1, 0), slides.length - 1);
step = Math.min(hashStep || 0, stepsOf(slides[idx]));
show(true, step === 0);

document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
  fitTitles();
  show(false, false);
});

/* ───────────── kurasu ───────────── */

// kurasu counts slides and steps from 1 and gives a slide without inner steps one step, so the deck's
// step 0 is kurasu's step 1.
if (framed) {
  window.parent.postMessage({
    type: "kurasu:manifest",
    slides: slides.map((s) => ({ steps: stepsOf(s) + 1 })),
  }, "*");

  addEventListener("message", (e) => {
    const go = e.data;

    if (e.source !== window.parent || go?.type !== "kurasu:go" || !Number.isInteger(go.slide) || !Number.isInteger(go.step)) {
      return;
    }

    if (!embedded) {
      embedded = true;
      $("#hud").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    const nextIdx = Math.min(Math.max(go.slide - 1, 0), slides.length - 1);
    const nextStep = Math.min(Math.max(go.step - 1, 0), stepsOf(slides[nextIdx]));
    const forward = nextIdx > idx || (nextIdx === idx && nextStep >= step);
    const entered = nextIdx !== idx;

    if (!entered && nextStep === step) {
      return;
    }

    idx = nextIdx;
    step = nextStep;
    show(entered, forward);
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
